theorem regionS {Q Q₀ : ℝ} (hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q) (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀)
    (hρ : Real.log Q₀ ≤ 0.6 * Real.log Q) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (hR : 1 ≤ Q₀ / (s * q)) {c' : ℝ} (hc' : 0 < c') (hlq : 3 ≤ Real.log q)
    (hcc : Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log c' +
      2.50637 / Real.log (Real.log q) ≤ 0.86)
    (hh : Real.log q + 1.039 * (Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ c' * ((q : ℝ) * (Q₀ / (s * q))) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9)) :
    Gq q (Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ (Real.log Q₀ + 1.36) / (Real.log Q + cE) * Gq q (Q / (s * q)) :=

note: Not stated in Lean; regionS bounds P/φ(P) via RS62 Thm 15 and ψ(n) ≤ 1.03883n, which in Lean depend on PlattGRH, where the book quotes unconditional RS62/RS75. Erratum: The proof says t -> a + b/t increases for t >= sqrt(b/a); it decreases, and the function used is at + b/t (sqrt(b/a) = 1.18627, i.e. N >= 26.44) (checked by `scripts/checks/lemma_12_2_1.py`).
